An '''unidentified jungle world''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kamdon system/Legends|Kamdon system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. It was surrounded by an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].

==History==
During the Republic's height, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] journeyed to the world following the failed [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. Residing on the world for twelve years [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] on her failure, Kuro eventually left the world to return to active duty on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After her initial departure, [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] businessmen [[Lekket]] and [[Tallet]] hired the failed Padawan-turned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to hunt down and kill [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] for his role in their banishment from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Sing, who was also hunting down her former master, tracked both Tikkes and Master Kuro to Cophrigin where she planned to murder both of them. Attacking Kuro's retreat, Kuro, Tikkes, and a Jedi task force [[Hunt for Aurra Sing|escaped]] Sing during a meteor shower which rained down on Kuro's retreat during the attack.<ref name="HFAS" />
